newsitem.title: USA: Mid Am says reauthorizes 1.5 mln buyback.
newsitem.headline: Mid Am says reauthorizes 1.5 mln buyback.

text.p: Mid Am Inc said Friday its board reauthorized its share buyback plan, enabling it to buy up to 1.5 million additional shares of the Company's outstanding common stock during a 12 month period.
Mid Am said it can also buy preferred stock on a conversion-equivalent basis.
The company said the purchases are to be made in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
The reauthorization follows the expiration of the Mid Am's share buyback program, under which it repurchased 437,077 shares of its common stock.
The company said the share buyback is expected to allow it to restructure its balance sheet and enhance shareholder returns.
The repurchased shares may be reissued according to future stock dividends or in connection with its stock option plan.
